tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Page background and the fill of inputs, buttons and table cells.

tokens.name: subtle
tokens.usage: Table headers, filter panels, row hover, the drawing ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Chips, segmented control track, tertiary hover, disabled fields.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Pressed tertiary buttons and pressed chips.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers, table rules, card edges. Decorative: a label or content always marks the element.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes. Meets 3:1 where it alone shows the control.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Headings, body, values. 17.6:1 (light), 15.9:1 (dark) on canvas.

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Descriptions, spec labels, nav links. 6.8:1 (light), 7.6:1 (dark) on canvas.

tokens.name: text-3
tokens.usage: Captions, metadata, placeholders, units. 4.6:1 (light), 5.2:1 (dark) on canvas. Not on muted or darker.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: Primary button fill, selected segment, current page in pagination.

tokens.name: inverse-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Label on inverse.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The signal color: selection marker, focus ring, annotation leaders and markers, overlines, the key data series. Less than 5% of a screen. Set per company with data-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent link hover.

tokens.name: accent-subtle
tokens.usage: Selected cell or row, grid overlay.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill, for example the reference marker J1.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Lifecycle Preview, neutral notices, transform actions.

tokens.name: info-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind info.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Lifecycle Active, passed check.

tokens.name: success-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Lifecycle NRND, change notices, design limits.

tokens.name: warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind warning.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Lifecycle End of life, errors, security advisories.

tokens.name: danger-subtle
tokens.usage: Fill behind danger.

tokens.name: grid-line
tokens.usage: The 16px grid behind drawings and diagrams.

tokens.name: draw-fill
tokens.usage: Fill of drawn parts in a technical drawing.

tokens.name: draw-stroke
tokens.usage: Outline of drawn parts.

tokens.name: draw-line
tokens.usage: Dimension lines, inner edges, hidden lines.

tokens.name: draw-dim
tokens.usage: Dimension text in drawings.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: The dark band: cover and footer. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: band-line
tokens.usage: Rules on band.

tokens.name: band-text
tokens.usage: Text on band.

tokens.name: band-text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and links on band (7.3:1).

tokens.name: accent-option-copper
tokens.usage: Accent option 1 (default). White label 5.5:1 in light; #0e1116 label 7.3:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-option-cobalt
tokens.usage: Accent option 2. White label 6.1:1 in light; #0e1116 label 7.2:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-option-teal
tokens.usage: Accent option 3. White label 5.5:1 in light; #0e1116 label 8.8:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-option-graphite
tokens.usage: Accent option 4, monochrome. Use when the company color is red or green, so it does not clash with status color.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Medium weight with tight tracking. Never uppercase, never bold.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Cover or category hero. Once per page. 40px below 600px width.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: Four buses in, only the frames you choose out

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Product name in the product header. 28px below 600px width.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body text stays near 65 characters wide.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Four isolated CAN FD channels record at up to 8 Mbit/s each.
styles.usage: Lead under a section title or product name.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Load your DBC file to filter by signal name.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Group labels and section eyebrows only. In accent above a section title.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: Part numbers, versions, register values, dimensions, dates.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Codes and numbers in text and tables.

spacing.note: 4px base. 8 to 24 inside components, 32 to 64 between groups, 80 to 128 between page sections.

tokens.name: s-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label in badges.

tokens.name: s-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons; gap between chips.

tokens.name: s-3
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; table cell padding block.

tokens.name: s-4
tokens.usage: Table cell padding inline; field gap.

tokens.name: s-5
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between form fields.

tokens.name: s-6
tokens.usage: Gap between figure columns; page gutter from 600px.

tokens.name: s-7
tokens.usage: Gap between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: s-8
tokens.usage: Gap between large blocks.

tokens.name: s-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on wide screens.

tokens.name: s-10
tokens.usage: Cover padding on wide screens.

radius.note: Small radii keep the technical character.

tokens.name: r-1
tokens.usage: Badges, tags, reference markers, checkboxes.

tokens.name: r-2
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, chips, nav hover.

tokens.name: r-3
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, notices, form panels.

tokens.name: r-4
tokens.usage: Drawings, page frames, the mega menu.

tokens.name: r-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and LED circles only.

shadow.note: Flat surfaces use a 1px border. Shadows are only for layers that float over content.

tokens.name: shadow-2
tokens.usage: Menus and the mega menu.

tokens.name: shadow-3
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Max content width. Margins: 16px below 600px, 32px to 1023px, 40px above.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Medium buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-h-s
tokens.usage: Small buttons in toolbars and tables.

tokens.name: control-h-l
tokens.usage: Large buttons in the product header.

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Site header.

tokens.name: secbar-h
tokens.usage: Sticky section bar on product pages.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: Grid behind drawings.

motion.note: Motion confirms an action. It never decorates. Respect reduced motion.

tokens.name: t-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, focus.

tokens.name: t-base
tokens.usage: Expand, tab change, highlight a path.

tokens.name: t-slow
tokens.usage: Mega menu, drawer.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: All transitions.
